summary.text: Mary Lehman is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 21, where she has served since January 9, 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Lehman's 2025-2026 committee assignments, according to Ballotpedia, are the Audit and Evaluation Committee, the Chesapeake and Atlantic Coastal Bays Critical Area Committee, and the Environment and Transportation Committee.
